description: Mint a scoped Client-Side key (player, uploader, or share) via POST /v1/api_key. Requires an API Access key. The full key is returned once — do not commit or log it. Share keys require exactly one variant and ignore expires_at. Cannot create API Access ("api") or URL Signing ("signing") keys (both dashboard-only). The player key is the client-safe credential to ship in a mobile/native app (creates play sessions only; see the native-playback guide). track_id requires collection_id. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_create_client_key
